layers.title: Base: tokens and core surfaces
layers.summary: Defines the Flatcap tokens (`--fc-*`) for each theme, then paints the toolbars, bookmark bar, panels and status bar, the address and search fields, the active tab and toolbar button hover, adds a 2px focus ring and the text-selection colors, turns off font ligatures in the address field, and follows `prefers-contrast: more`. Generated by `scripts/build.py`.

layers.title: Quick Commands (F2)
layers.summary: Quick Commands popup: raised surface, up to 640px wide, 22px search input, a distinct selected row with an inset bar, URL and shortcut hierarchy, the core overlay shadow. Text is 13px or larger. Row heights and positions are not touched.

layers.title: Quick Commands entry motion
layers.summary: Replaces the native Quick Commands entry with a 140ms fade and 4px rise. The list resizes immediately while you type. Off under reduced motion.

layers.title: Button feedback
layers.summary: 120ms background-color feedback on toolbar and bookmark-bar buttons. Press and keyboard focus are immediate. Off under reduced motion.

layers.title: Popup, panel and tab timing
layers.summary: Retimes Vivaldi's own popup entry (140ms transform, 120ms opacity) and exit (100ms fade), the overlay-panel width transition (140ms, off while you drag the panel edge) and the hover feedback of inactive tabs (120ms). Off under reduced motion.

layers.title: Minimal tabs
layers.summary: Inactive tabs lose their background and border (secondary text color); hover uses the hover surface; the active tab is a raised surface. Tab size, icons, stacks, marked tabs, drop targets and accordions are left alone.

layers.title: Subtle address field border
layers.summary: Draws the address field border in the quiet `border.subtle` color at rest and in `border.control` on hover. Keyboard focus keeps the base's 2px focus ring. **Documented accessibility exception:** at rest the border is below the 3:1 outline target (see Accessibility).

layers.title: Quiet tab audio indicator
layers.summary: Keeps Vivaldi's native audio icon and states but removes the hover movement, rounds it and gives it a hover surface and a focus ring.

layers.title: Downloads panel and popup
layers.summary: Flatcap surface for the downloads panel and popup, readable file size, accent progress bar on a subtle track, a divider above the editor. Row sizes, warnings, controls and the unknown-size progress are left alone.

layers.title: Extensions dropdown as a list
layers.summary: When extensions live in the dropdown, shows them as a 280px vertical list with the extension name as a visible label. Pinned toolbar icons and extension popups are not touched. GPL-3.0 (see Third-party code).

layers.title: Expanded extensions group
layers.summary: When you expand the extensions group in the toolbar, gives it a raised surface, a subtle inset border and rounded corners, and fades the icons in over 140ms. No width animation. Off under reduced motion.
